name: LayeredDepthCard
job: A card built from stacked flat layers (background, product, shadow, label) that separate in parallax as the card tilts
visitor_action: move pointer or tilt to separate layers; on touch, dragging shifts the layers; arrow keys shift them when focused
mobile: slow idle float, drag to shift layers
motion: layers translate by depth with smoothed pointer easing, balloon and hanging tag swing as pendulums, staged paper-by-paper entrance (reduced-motion: layers locked at a gentle offset)
provenance: original, built from a concept description
art_direction: Paper theatre: layered matte cut-paper in dusk coral and indigo, soft stepped shadows between planes, grainy print texture
notes: Defaults are painted in code (dusk sky, paper hot-air balloon) so no cut-out image is needed; setting a background or foreground image swaps those planes. Self-hosted Gabarito font. Not yet seen in a browser: layout positions were set by calculation only. 2026-11-23: targeted fix (Sonnet 5.5, QA near-pass): title floor raised above the near-hill tips so it is never covered at any length; hanging tag width capped to the string anchor and clamped to 5 lines so text stays inside the card. Pending QA re-sweep. 2026-11-23: surgical fix 2 (worst-375): long captions (>90 chars) at narrow widths get a tighter size and lower position so they clear the title above.
